_note: Stub book for the chat lab only. The plugin reads the server's own recipe registry; this handful exists so you can see how Scuttle behaves when the book answers, and how it behaves when it doesn't. Keys are lowercase.

chest.item: A container. Stacks to 64, made of wood, burns.
chest.recipe: Crafting table: 8 planks in a ring around an empty middle. Makes 1 chest.

furnace.recipe: Crafting table: 8 cobblestone in a ring around an empty middle. Makes 1 furnace.

crafting table.item: The 3x3 crafting grid. Stacks to 64, burns.
crafting table.recipe: Crafting table: 4 planks in a 2x2 square. Makes 1 crafting table.

hopper.item: Moves items between containers. Stacks to 64.
hopper.recipe: Crafting table: 5 iron ingots in a V, with a chest in the middle. Makes 1 hopper.

piston.item: Pushes blocks when powered. Stacks to 64.
piston.recipe: Crafting table: 3 planks across the top, cobblestone down both sides and along the bottom, 1 iron ingot in the middle, 1 redstone dust below it. Makes 1 piston.

sticky piston.item: A piston that pulls blocks back. Stacks to 64.
sticky piston.recipe: Crafting table: 1 slimeball on top of 1 piston. Makes 1 sticky piston.

observer.item: Sends a redstone pulse when the block in front of it changes. Stacks to 64.
observer.recipe: Crafting table: 6 cobblestone, 2 redstone dust and 1 nether quartz. Makes 1 observer.

torch.recipe: Crafting table or inventory: 1 coal or charcoal above 1 stick. Makes 4 torches.

ladder.recipe: Crafting table: 7 sticks in an H shape. Makes 3 ladders.

bucket.item: Carries water, lava or milk. Stacks to 16.
bucket.recipe: Crafting table: 3 iron ingots in a V. Makes 1 bucket.
